patch_description: Replace the expensive reflection-heavy 40-start search with a more geometrically diverse 12-start portfolio. The prior reflections mostly duplicate the same contact graph, while asymmetric five-row layouts move the six-circle layers relative to square boundaries and can produce genuinely different wall/diagonal tangency structures. Each of six distinct layouts contributes one equal-radius continuation start and one row-sheared direct unequal-radius start. This both emphasizes promising asymmetric hexagonal-layer arrangements and substantially reduces runtime, leaving the final polishing pass to refine the strongest basin.
